'''2012 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 John Veasey DS A Stunning Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[John Veasey]] at [[2012 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[A Stunning Move]]
* '''Username:''' veez
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
